title: A pool run's list cost leaves out a kb arm's web searches and overcounts a Sonnet or Opus off-kb run, so pool verify (b) fails the smoke record
goal: On the 2026-10-08 smoke record (_cache/scratch/ST-xy5kmisr/smoke/pool-smoke.csv, runs in the bench scratch runs file) six runs were more than 20% off their list price: Haiku 5.5 kb-arm runs cost 2 to 4 times list (BP-90da6231, BP-4d1528e8, BP-46067e5e: web searches at 0.01 USD each not priced on a kb arm, to be confirmed), and Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 runs of the off-kb row BP-4d1528e8 cost 25 to 38% under list (cause unproven: find it). Each run's list cost (bench_pool.list_usd through bench_core.est_cost) prices every billed part the run's stream reports, on every arm, so a rerun of those rows lands within 20% of each run's reported cost; the cause of the under-list runs is found from a raw stream (paid probe runs that keep their stream, at most 1 USD in all, approved by the operator on 2026-10-08) and named in the fix's commit; a planted stream for each cause is priced within 20% of its reported cost

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_pool; r={'arm':'haiku-5-5','model':'claude-haiku-5-5','cost':0.05,'out':100,'uncached':10,'cache_write':1000,'cache_read':1000,'searches':4,'requests':[{'model':'claude-haiku-5-5','usage':{'input_tokens':10,'cache_creation_input_tokens':1000,'cache_read_input_tokens':1000,'output_tokens':100}}]}; l=bench_pool.list_usd(r); assert l>=0.04, l

repro_reason: The smoke record's rows are fixed figures a code fix does not change; the repro plants a kb-arm run with four web searches.

gates.question: A Sonnet 5.5 probe run reports a cost that prices its cache reads at 0.20 USD per MTok, while the pricing page (S2131) and PRICE say 0.10: which read price does PRICE keep for Sonnet 5.5?
options: Keep the pricing page's 0.10 (a Sonnet run's list cost reads about 8% under its reported cost, inside the 20% bound)
Change to 0.20 to match the cost the CLI reports
gates.recommendation: Keep the pricing page's 0.10 (a Sonnet run's list cost reads about 8% under its reported cost, inside the 20% bound)
gates.answer: Price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at the billed 0.20 (changed: smoke 3 showed every cache-heavy Sonnet session run 20% over list at 0.10; BG-pv3hl6aa implements it and records the conflict with the page's 0.10; decided by the orchestrator under the operator's unattended approval of 2026-10-09)
